_meta.description: ENT-658 regression fixture for google-antigravity /demos/threadid-frontend-tool-roundtrip. First turn emits a frontend tool call; follow-up turn confirms the tool result without changing threads.
_meta.googleAntigravityStaging: google-antigravity staging: the Antigravity Go harness owns the conversation history and never sends role:"tool" messages -- a completed tool call comes back as an assistant message whose text is 'Tool response for <name>: ...'. hasToolResult/toolCallId therefore never fire here, so every leg is staged on turnIndex (aimock's count of assistant messages; +2 per tool round-trip, +1 per text answer). turnIndex is a POSITION disambiguator, not a reject gate (aimock selectByTurnIndex): the candidate with the highest turnIndex <= assistantCount wins, so a leg must carry EVERY absolute position a test can reach it from -- a fresh thread (0/2) AND its slot in a multi-pill single-thread sequence.

fixtures._comment: Turn 1: emit the frontend tool call. Staged at turnIndex 0 — the previous follow-up entry was gated on toolCallId, which never fires on this integration (the Go harness sends no role:"tool" messages), so its untagged leg-1 partner re-emitted testFrontendToolCalling on every iteration.
Turn 2: confirm the tool result, one round-trip later.
